COMPLETE WET FOOD - LICK YOUR PAWS CLEAN!
Choosing the right cat food is important and you need to consider many aspects. It should be tasty but also carry healthy benefits.
Do you choose kibble or wet food? Well, why not both?
The kibble is available all day for your fluffy housemate, while the wet food in turn provides a daily culinary highlight. Cats just love wet food!
HEALTH BENEFITS OF WET FOOD FOR CATS
✔️ Delectable and full flavour

Cats are known for their fussy eating habits. Wet food has a more pleasant smell and taste for cats than dry food, which makes it very appealing to them. If your cat is culinary hard to please, wet food may be the solution to stimulate her appetite. Sounds purrr-fect!
✔️ Increases fluid intake

Cats generally don’t drink much. Our pâté contains a high moisture content (>80%). This makes it the ideal food to increase your cat's fluid intake and pamper your cat in a healthy and responsible way!
✔️ Healthy urinary tract through increased fluid intake
The high moisture content in our pâté makes urine thinner and less concentrated. This is important to prevent bladder stones and other urinary tract problems.
✔️ Weight management
Another added benefit of more moisture: it means a less calorific meal while offering a greater sense of satiety. Win-win!
✔️ Healthy digestion
Consuming wet food makes stools softer. This is especially important for cats that don’t drink enough.

Acookie is a small text file that is stored by your browser (for example Internet Explorer or Safari) on your device (for example on your computer or phone). They enable websites to store user information such as preferences and settings. In principle, cookies enable websites to remember users and their preference settings for that particular website, so that the website can respond accordingly and can gain more insight into regular visitors of the website.

Functional cookies: These are necessary for a proper operation of the website. They ensure, for instance, that the desired information is shown quickly and correctly each time you visit our website. No consent is needed for placing functional cookies.

For example how often our website is visited, on which page you enter our website and the areas on our website that are visited most frequently. No consent is needed for placing these cookies because there are no privacy consequences.

Social media plug-in cookies: Social media plug-in cookies are used to show social media content on our website. We ask for your consent for placing these cookies.
